51K likes, 544 comments - mridul_sharmaa on February 24, 2026: "The GOLDEN Play Button is finally home and I still catch myself just staring at it🥹

Pressing upload nine years ago was the bravest and best decision I ever made. And I’d do it all over again.

Thank you for growing with me, believing in me, and turning something small into something extraordinary. This belongs to all of us🧿".

posts.meta_description:
17K likes, 338 comments - mridul_sharmaa on October 15, 2024: "Pinching myself because I can hardly believe it! We’ve made it to the @forbesindia India Top 100 Digital Creators list for the second time in a row! And this time Ranked at #14🥹🥹

This journey has been filled with highs, challenges, and growth, and it’s all thanks to the support from each and every one of you. From my first post to today, you’ve been a part of it all, and I couldn’t be more grateful.
To my amazing community, this win is ours. I’m beyond excited to continue this journey and see where it takes us. 
Here’s to chasing dreams, breaking barriers, and creating something beautiful together✨
Cannot NOT thank @aditya_naik for being there from LITERALLY the first day I started! Clicking pictures for my blogs, shooting video for YouTube and always believing in me (even when I didn’t)🧿

#ForbesIndiaTop100
#GratefulBeyondWords".

4,912 likes, 94 comments - mridul_sharmaa on October 2, 2026: "Festive season means going all out with the glam, not the effort✨

This season, I’m keeping my base fresh, flawless and shine-free with the @maybelline_ind Super Stay Matte Max Cushion Foundation. Just Press, Pat & Play for all-day coverage in 30 seconds. No brush or sponge needed.

The 0.01mm filtering mesh dispenses just the right amount every time, so there’s no need to tap off excess. Plus, it’s infused with Niacinamide & Panthenol, SPF 30 PA+++, and delivers up to 30H of flawless wear.

Lightweight, portable and perfect for on-the-go touch-ups, this one definitely deserves a spot in your festival makeup kit.

Add it to your festival lineup and get ready to glam, effortlessly.

#AD #AllDayFlawlessBaseIn30Seconds #MaybellineIndia #MaybellineMakeup".

4,904 likes, 56 comments - mridul_sharmaa on September 30, 2026: "I’ll admit it, a good jelly texture and a cool colour palette will get my attention every time🥰

This time @plumgoodness Black Rice & 10% Niacinamide-TXA Jelly Serum did. It combines 7% Niacinamide + 3% Tranexamic Acid to target pigmentation, dark spots and stubborn acne marks.

The ActiveHold™️ Jelly Formula creates a breathable, long-contact layer to help maximise overnight efficacy while your skin gets busy with its repair mode.

basically, my night shift has a new teammate.
cute texture. serious skincare⭐️ #ad".
